scope: Create and start one independent Coolify Raw Application for synthetic, internal-only PIT Rust V2 traffic; no V1, neighbor, proxy configuration, Cloudflare, DNS, payment or external chain-write changes.

coolify.permitted_management_side_effect: Coolify may create deployment records, a helper container, temporary files and an Application management network and attach coolify-proxy only to that otherwise empty management network. The shared proxy must not join any V2 service network.

database.name: pit_crypto_v2
database.backup_and_restore: After first successful migration, create a PIT-V2-only pg_dump in a private temporary operator-managed path and restore it into a separate disposable PIT-V2-only database; do not access or change V1 backups. Delete only disposable restore fixtures. A scheduled backup is required before real users.

secrets.mechanism: Coolify private runtime variables generated separately for V2; values never stored in Git, manifest or logs
secrets.private_origin_policy: Set PIT_V2_ALLOWED_ORIGIN exactly to https://pit-v2.invalid for this internal-only canary; this reserved .invalid name has no DNS record or public browser route.

single_authorized_attempt.before_start: Recheck manifest/source/image hashes, actual Coolify version and saved Raw settings, five V2-only variables present without values, no domain/ports/hooks/autodeploy/extra networks, no existing V2 app, no concurrent deployment, host headroom, TLS and DeOpt/HBI/Toolio health. Stop if any check fails.
single_authorized_attempt.start: Allow one standard Coolify Raw deployment only; no custom config --quiet job. Coolify may materialize its management resources before container startup. No second automatic attempt.
single_authorized_attempt.immediately_after_start: Inspect actual generated Compose, Docker labels, all PIT and proxy network memberships, host port bindings, Traefik routers, effective cgroup CPU/RAM, image digests, migration exit, health and secrets-by-name. If proxy joins a V2 service network, or any public route/port or foreign mount appears, stop all new V2 containers before functional smoke; preserve V1 and both database volumes.
single_authorized_attempt.smoke: Synthetic invitation and scoped HMAC requests; reject unsigned/replayed requests and hosted NFT jobs; bounded Base Sepolia eth_chainId, eth_getLogs, events export, permissions and distribution read-only jobs; worker restart/recovery; PIT-V2-only backup/restore; no external transaction or email.
single_authorized_attempt.observe: Measure PIT CPU/RAM, VPS available memory/CPU pressure/disk, restarts/OOM and job latency; recheck DeOpt, HBI, Toolio and TLS. Stop only V2 on material neighbor degradation.
single_authorized_attempt.rollback: Stop only newly created V2 API, worker and database containers; preserve V2 volume and all V1 resources. Do not restart or manually alter shared Traefik. Remove only V2 management resources after checking their membership and ownership.
single_authorized_attempt.residual_risk: Coolify's generated Compose and management network are only fully observable during the one controlled start. A transient network attachment could exist before immediate post-start inspection; this is restricted to synthetic internal traffic with no public route. Stop and report rather than retry if isolation fails.
